paite: Huchi in bil a ka zak in, "Khopi kem mite michih hihmanna van tawi in hong nai uhen," chi in ngaihtak in akikou hi.
heading: Jerusalem Sawi In A-om
english: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”

paite: Huan ngai in, mallam kongpi tungnung paina a kipan in mi guk ahong pai ua, michih in hihlupna van atawi chiat ua; alai ua mi khat puanmalngat silh in laituibuk akuah hi. Alut ua, dal maitam kiang ah adingh uhi.
english: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.

paite: Huan Israel' Pathian thupina a omna cherub a kipan in huai inn kongpi kiang ah apaitou a; puanmalngat silh, laituibuk kuahpa asam hi.
english: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Khopi sung tawnsuak inla, Jerusalem tawnsuak in; asung a thilkihhuai hihsate ziak atunggik a kapte atal uah chiamteh in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”

paite: Huan midangte kiang ah ka zak mahmah in, "Anung ah khopi tawnsuak unla, khut kha un, na mit un mumaih kei henla, hehpih sam kei un.
english: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.

paite: Putekte, tangvalte, nungakte, naupangte leh nute that siang vek un. Chiamtehna neite bel hon naih kei un; ka Mun Siangthou ah pan un," achi hi. Huchi in inn kong a upate ah apan uhi.
english: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then they began at the old men who were before the house.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Inn hihbuah unla, ahuangsungte mi luang in dimsak unla, pawt un," achi hi. Huan apawtta ua, khopi ah agamtangta uhi.
english: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out, and struck in the city.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khopi ah agamtat lai un kei bel nutsiat in ka na om a, akhup in ka puk hi. "Ah! Toupa PATHIAN, Jerusalem tung a na hehna na sunbuak ah Israel khosuaksunte leng hihman vek sawm na hi hiam?" chi in ka kikou hi.
english: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”

paite: Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Israel leh Judah inkote thulimlouhna athupi tel a ahi. 'Sisan in gamsung adim a; khopi vaihawmna kaihkawi in a-om a, TOUPA'N gam apaisanta a, TOUPA'N bangmah amu kei!' achi hi.
english: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘Yahweh has forsaken the land, and Yahweh doesn’t see.’

paite: Kei toh kisai in leng, ka mit in amau ka mumaih kei ding a, ka hehpih sam kei ding hi; agitlouhna uh avekpi in amau ka khusak ding," achi hi.
english: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”

paite: Huchi in ngai in, puanmalngat silh a laituibuk kuahpa'n thu atun a, "N'on thupiak bang in ka hih khinta," achi hi.
english: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”
